note: Federal officeholders for the dynamic questions in civics-128. This file is the BUNDLED copy. At runtime the app first tries to fetch a fresher copy from ./dynamic-answers.json on the site (data-only update, no app release) and falls back to this bundled copy when offline or when the remote copy is missing or older. Every entry carries its own validity window - an answer is only trusted until its validUntil date, then the freshness checker flags it stale. Status values: official (verified in office) | projected (election called by AP but certification or the seating vote is still ahead).

chiefJustice.explanation: John Roberts - Chief Justice since 2005. Federal judges are appointed for life, so this answer changes only when the Chief Justice leaves the court and a successor is appointed and confirmed.
chiefJustice.hookWordplay: John Roberts wears the ROBE - ROBE-rts has led the Supreme Court since 2005.
chiefJustice.name: John Roberts
chiefJustice.role: Chief Justice of the United States
chiefJustice.source: https://www.supremecourt.gov/visiting/activities/pdf/supremecourt101_january2026.pdf (official Supreme Court guide, Jan 2026 ed., crawled 2026-11-06: Chief Justice John G. Roberts, Jr., seated since Sep 29, 2005; justices serve during good Behaviour, life tenure).

president.explanation: Donald Trump - the 47th President, inaugurated January 20, 2025.
president.hookWordplay: A TRUMP-et announces the leader of the band - Donald Trump, the 47th President.
president.name: Donald Trump
president.source: https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/jd-vance/ and https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2026/10/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-adjusts-imports-of-robotics-industrial-machinery-and-their-parts-and-components-into-the-united-states/ (both crawled 2026-11-06); term end noon Jan 20, 2029 per the 20th Amendment.

speaker.explanation: Mike Johnson of Louisiana - Speaker of the House for the 119th Congress, re-elected Speaker in January 2025.
speaker.hookWordplay: The Speaker speaks for the whole House - Mike Johnson holds the gavel.
speaker.name: Mike Johnson
speaker.role: Speaker of the House of Representatives
speaker.source: https://history.house.gov/Congressional-Overview/Profiles/119th/ (crawled 2026-11-06: Speaker of the House: Mike Johnson, R-Louisiana; he serves until the 119th Congress ends at noon on Jan 3, 2027).

vicePresident.explanation: JD Vance - Vice President since January 20, 2025, President Trump's running mate.
vicePresident.hookWordplay: JD Vance rides in the VAN right behind the President - the VP is always one step behind, ready to step in.
vicePresident.name: JD Vance
vicePresident.role: Vice President of the United States
vicePresident.source: https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/jd-vance/ (crawled 2026-11-06, page title: Vice President JD Vance).

pending.note: Democrats won the House majority in the Nov 3, 2026 midterms (AP call on Nov 4, 2026; results are unofficial until state certification, which runs into December 2026). Hakeem Jeffries, the House Democratic leader, is expected to be elected Speaker when the 120th Congress convenes - but he is NOT Speaker until the full House votes on Jan 3, 2027. Mike Johnson remains the correct answer until noon on Jan 3, 2027. Democratic caucus leadership vote expected Nov 18, 2026 - if Jeffries wins it, raise this entry's confidence; the answer still flips only on Jan 3, 2027 after the floor vote. Data action on Jan 3, 2027: verify the floor-vote result on house.gov / clerk.house.gov, then move the winner into offices.speaker with validFrom 2027-01-03 and validUntil 2029-01-03.
